lines.text: Many learners say: Thank you. Welcome.
Better: Thank you. You are welcome.
Say you are welcome to answer thanks.

data.why: Say you are welcome to answer thanks.

native.tip: نرد على الشكر بـ «أهلًا»، لكن welcome للضيف، وللرد نقول you are welcome: “Thank you. You are welcome.” وليس “Thank you. Welcome.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “Thank you. Welcome.” 😅 نرد على الشكر بـ «أهلًا»، لكن welcome للضيف، وللرد نقول you are welcome، فالجملة الصحيحة “Thank you. You are welcome.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “You are welcome” — نرد على الشكر بـ «أهلًا»، لكن welcome للضيف، وللرد نقول you are welcome. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: We answer thanks with «أهلًا», but welcome is for guests, so we say you are welcome: “Thank you. You are welcome.” not “Thank you. Welcome.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Thank you. Welcome.” 😅 We often answer thanks with «أهلًا», but welcome is for guests. The right sentence is “Thank you. You are welcome.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
